name: tokenremain-windows
description: TokenRemain for Windows with local usage and encrypted direct Mac sync

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/feed.js && node --check electron/local-usage.js && node --check electron/pricing.js && node --check electron/popover-placement.js && node --check electron/providers/catalog.js && node --check electron/providers/detection.js && node --check electron/providers/index.js && node --check electron/providers/local-session.js && node --check electron/providers/manual.js && node --check electron/providers/shared.js && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --x64 --win nsis --publish never
